messages.subject: MCMCSki early registration
parts:
If you want to save 40 euros or so, the early registration
deadline is tomorrow (Oct 15). The form's very clunky (you need
to fill in hotel dates even if you don't book a hotel) and
my credit card company rejected the payment, so I had to first talk
to the credit card company, then fill out the clunky form
again.

- Bob
